notes:

• No new features since 0.2.27. If you already have 0.2.27, this update changes nothing you will notice.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.2.25 or newer cannot be restored on an older version.

iPhone (test build): FinUtopia-0.2.28-ios-unsigned.ipa installs with Sideloadly (sideloadly.io) or AltStore and your Apple ID, on iOS 15 or newer. With a free Apple ID, install it again every 7 days. Your data stays. The folder backup is Android only.
